Package com.csse3200.game.maps

Class RunState

java.lang.Object
com.csse3200.game.maps.RunState
public class RunState extends Object
Holds the map and the player's progress for the length of a run.

Screens get disposed when the game switches away from them, so the map can't be owned by the map screen or it would be lost every time the player enters an encounter. GdxGame holds this instead.

    • enterEncounter

      public void enterEncounter(Integer nodeId)
      Remembers the node the player entered so the encounter can report back against it. Any node still marked current is one the player passed through without an encounter, i.e. the node they started on, so it is closed off here.
